notableFindings: Cheoy Lee 33 corrected to documented 32 Trawler; 36 Sedan corrected to 36 Trawler Mk II, with production years left unresolved.
Californian 34/38 corrected to 34 LRC and 38 LRC Sedan, which are modified-V cruisers rather than full-displacement trawlers.
Gulfstar 39 corrected to 1981–84 Sailmaster motorsailer; Gulfstar 49 corrected to 1984–87 Motor Yacht.
Ocean Alexander 36/39 remain Initial because early small-model documentation is incomplete; 39 Sedan identity is supported by surviving 1986 examples.
Tollycraft 34 corrected to 34 Sport Sedan (1987–93); 37 Sedan retained Initial pending a stronger model-wide specification source.
Uniflite 36 Double Cabin normalized and 1984 36 II variation documented.
Universal, Mariner, Seahorse and Sealord records remain conservative where model-wide documentation is weak.
Transpacific Marine Eagle 32 normalized to documented 1985–98 Pilothouse identity with hull-specific machinery/tankage variation.
